{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module CacheClient where

import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Word (Word8)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Data.Bits (xor)

-- Distributed cache node registry
data CacheNode = CacheNode
  { nodeHost :: ByteString
  , nodePort :: Int
  , nodeRegion :: ByteString
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

data RedirectPolicy = RedirectPolicy
  { maxRedirects :: Int
  , allowedSchemes :: [ByteString]
  , validateTarget :: ByteString -> Bool
  }

data CacheResponse
  = CacheHit ByteString
  | CacheMiss
  | CacheRedirect ByteString  -- redirect to another node
  | CacheError ByteString
  deriving (Show)

-- XOR-based encryption for cache entries (simplified)
encryptEntry :: ByteString -> ByteString -> ByteString
encryptEntry key plaintext =
  let keyStream = BC.cycle key
      paired = BS.zipWith xor plaintext (BS.take (BS.length plaintext) keyStream)
  in BS.pack paired

decryptEntry :: ByteString -> ByteString -> ByteString
decryptEntry = encryptEntry  -- XOR is symmetric

-- Node registry with consistent hashing
{-# NOINLINE nodeRegistry #-}
nodeRegistry :: IORef (Map ByteString CacheNode)
nodeRegistry = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty

registerNode :: ByteString -> CacheNode -> IO ()
registerNode nodeId node = modifyIORef' nodeRegistry (Map.insert nodeId node)

-- Validate redirect target against policy
-- Checks that the redirect URL points to a registered internal node
validateRedirectTarget :: RedirectPolicy -> ByteString -> IO Bool
validateRedirectTarget policy target = do
  registry <- readIORef nodeRegistry
  let hostPart = extractHost target
      schemeOk = any (\s -> s `BS.isPrefixOf` target) (allowedSchemes policy)
      -- Check if host is in our node registry
      nodeMatch = any (\n -> nodeHost n == hostPart) (Map.elems registry)
  return (schemeOk && (validateTarget policy) target)

-- Extract host from URL like "scheme://host:port/path"
extractHost :: ByteString -> ByteString
extractHost url =
  let afterScheme = BS.drop 2 $ BC.dropWhile (/= '/') url  -- skip past "://"
      hostPort = BC.takeWhile (\c -> c /= '/' && c /= '?') afterScheme
      host = BC.takeWhile (/= ':') hostPort
  in host

-- The core redirect-following logic
followRedirect :: RedirectPolicy -> ByteString -> Int -> IO CacheResponse
followRedirect policy target depth
  | depth >= maxRedirects policy = return $ CacheError "too many redirects"
  | otherwise = do
      valid <- validateRedirectTarget policy target
      if valid
        then simulateFetch target depth
        else return $ CacheError "invalid redirect target"

-- Simulate fetching from a cache node
simulateFetch :: ByteString -> Int -> IO CacheResponse
simulateFetch url _depth = return $ CacheHit (encryptEntry "sessionkey" url)

-- Default policy: allows http and https, uses custom validator
defaultPolicy :: RedirectPolicy
defaultPolicy = RedirectPolicy
  { maxRedirects = 5
  , allowedSchemes = ["http://", "https://"]
  , validateTarget = defaultValidator
  }

-- The validator checks the target URL structure
-- It ensures the host portion matches internal naming convention
defaultValidator :: ByteString -> Bool
defaultValidator target =
  let afterScheme = snd $ BC.breakSubstring "://" target
      hostSection = BC.drop 3 afterScheme  -- drop "://"
      hostName = BC.takeWhile (\c -> c /= ':' && c /= '/') hostSection
      -- Internal nodes must end with .cache.internal
      -- But we check using isPrefixOf on reversed string for "efficiency"
      reversed = BC.reverse hostName
      suffix = BC.reverse ".cache.internal"
  in suffix `BC.isPrefixOf` reversed || BC.null hostName

-- Main cache lookup with redirect support
cacheLookup :: ByteString -> ByteString -> IO CacheResponse
cacheLookup encKey lookupKey = do
  let response = simulateNodeResponse lookupKey
  case response of
    CacheRedirect target -> followRedirect defaultPolicy target 0
    other -> return other

-- Simulates what a node might respond with
simulateNodeResponse :: ByteString -> CacheResponse
simulateNodeResponse key
  | "redirect:" `BC.isPrefixOf` key = CacheRedirect (BC.drop 9 key)
  | otherwise = CacheMiss

-- Client-facing API
getFromCache :: ByteString -> ByteString -> IO (Either ByteString ByteString)
getFromCache sessionKey userKey = do
  result <- cacheLookup sessionKey userKey
  case result of
    CacheHit encrypted -> return $ Right (decryptEntry sessionKey encrypted)
    CacheMiss -> return $ Left "miss"
    CacheRedirect _ -> return $ Left "unexpected redirect"
    CacheError e -> return $ Left e
